inputRule: All regular files under build top-level r18* entries, recursively; no symlinks/junctions

policy.png: Original bytes retained; no editing, pixel conversion, resize or re-encoding
policy.raw: gzip of original source bytes, including zero-byte logs and arbitrary native raw evidence; no text normalization
policy.deduplication: SHA256 of original bytes within each encoding; every logical source path retained
policy.semanticBoundary: Archive byte verification does not certify gameplay success. Preflight/setup, failures, source snapshots and actual acceptance remain distinct in their raw reports.

verbatim.scope: Final R18 production after real mode recovery fix
verbatim.historyBoundary: Helper internal redirection reused the v1 log path. Its earlier intermediate 774-test raw log was overwritten; only the previously observed intermediate total survives. Both archived v1/v2 log files now contain the identical final 809-test output; they are one execution, not two.

logHistoryClarification.boundary: This source clarification is preserved verbatim. Do not reconstruct or claim a retained intermediate raw log, and do not count identical v1/v2 final logs as separate executions.
